# Colorado health plan compare: API description

A free, public tool that prices and compares Colorado individual-market (ACA) health plans for people under 65, from the CMS 2026 plan data.
It exposes three stateless tools over MCP and plain REST. No login or key is needed.

## Endpoints
REST: POST https://healthplan-compare.vercel.app/api/engine/<tool> with a JSON body (Content-Type: application/json).
REST by GET, for clients that can only fetch URLs: https://healthplan-compare.vercel.app/api/engine/<tool>?<fields>, where each answer field below is a query parameter (children_ages and plan_ids are comma-separated; use none for no spouse or to skip income). rank_plans also takes sort, limit, metal, type, insurer, hsa_only and max_monthly_premium.
MCP (streamable HTTP, stateless JSON-RPC 2.0): POST https://healthplan-compare.vercel.app/mcp with the methods initialize, tools/list and tools/call.

## Tools
- next_question: takes the answers collected so far and returns the next questions to ask (status 'ask'), a reason the tool does not apply (status 'stop'), or status 'ready'.
- rank_plans: takes answers (optionally sort, limit, filter) and returns the best plan under five views of a year plus a ranked list, with an estimated premium tax credit when income is given.
- compare_plans: takes answers and plan_ids and returns the plans side by side with exact differences.
The tools keep no state: every call carries the full 'answers' object.

## The answers object
- coverage (choice): Optional, never asked: only set it if the user says they are on Medicare or Medicaid, so the tool can stop. Example: medicare, medicaid, employer or none
- age (whole number): How old is the main applicant? Example: 45
- spouse_age (whole number or null): Is a spouse or partner on the plan? If so, their age; otherwise null. Example: 43, or null for none
- children_ages (list of whole numbers): Are any children or other dependents on the plan? List their ages; use an empty list for none. Example: [4, 6, 8], or [] for none
- zip (5-digit ZIP): What is their Colorado home ZIP code? Example: 80202
- county_fips (county code): That ZIP code spans counties that are priced differently. Which county do they live in?
- tobacco (yes/no): Does anyone on the plan use tobacco? (Optional; defaults to no.)
- household_income (dollars per year or null): What is the household's expected income this year (before tax, including all earners)? This only checks whether they might qualify for premium credits. They may skip it (null). Example: 85000, or null to skip
- expected_care (choice): How much medical care do they expect this year? Pick the closest. Example: little = checkups only; ongoing = a condition or regular prescriptions; major = surgery, a baby or a hospital stay; unsure

## Example
curl -s -X POST https://healthplan-compare.vercel.app/api/engine/next_question -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"answers":{}}'
https://healthplan-compare.vercel.app/api/engine/rank_plans?age=40&spouse_age=38&children_ages=5,7,9&zip=80202&household_income=90000&expected_care=ongoing

## About the results
Every response carries its caveats and usageRules. The figures are educational estimates, not advice or a recommendation of any plan.
